1. (Currently amended) A method for content optimization, comprising: receiving a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the rule on probability factor, wherein the plurality of pieces of content are generated using a technical process that applies the rule on probability factor to control specific technical parameters of content generation; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use; determining, by a processor, an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; and modifying, by the processor, the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated performance data, wherein the modification is performed by the processor using a feedback control mechanism that adjusts the rule on probability factor to optimize content performance metrics.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a size or position adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, and wherein the content element comprises a technical display parameter that affects how content is rendered on a display device.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for aggregated performance data the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, and wherein the processor applies a statistical algorithm to calculate the deviation value and uses the deviation value to adjust the rule on probability factor in a manner that improves content performance optimization.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving a set of rules for content generation; identifying a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation; and composing, by the processor, one or more rules on probability factor for the changeable content attribute, wherein the composing step comprises automatically generating the one or more rules on probability factor using a technical algorithm that processes the set of rules for content generation to determine which content attributes are changeable and to establish initial probability distributions for those attributes.

8. (Currently amended) A content optimization system, comprising: a rule management module maintaining a set of rules for content generation, the set of rules comprising a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute; a content generation module operative to generate a plurality of pieces of content based on the set of rules, the plurality of pieces of content designed with a particular optimization objective, wherein the content generation module applies the rule on probability factor to control specific technical parameters of content generation; and a content evaluation module operative to evaluate content performance on reaching the particular optimization objective based on data acquired when the plurality of pieces of content are displayed, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the evaluated content performance, wherein the rule management module is operative to amend the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated content performance data using a feedback control mechanism that adjusts the rule on probability factor to optimize content performance metrics.

9. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, and wherein the content element comprises a technical display parameter that affects how content is rendered on a display device.

10. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine a deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, and wherein the rule management module is further operative to modify the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, and wherein the processor applies a statistical algorithm to calculate the deviation value and uses the deviation value to adjust the rule on probability factor in a manner that improves content performance optimization.

11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the rule management module is further operative to identify a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation and compose a rule on probability factor for the changeable content attribute, wherein the composing comprises automatically generating the rule on probability factor using a technical algorithm that processes the set of rules for content generation to determine which content attributes are changeable and to establish initial probability distributions for those attributes.

13. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving a first rule on probability factor and a second rule on probability factor, the first rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a first value of a selected content attribute, the second rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a second value of the selected content attribute, the second value being different from the first value; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor, wherein the plurality of pieces of content are generated using a technical process that applies the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor to control specific technical parameters of content generation; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use; determining, by a processor, a first aggregated performance data for the first value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; determining, by the processor, a second aggregated performance data for the second value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; and modifying, by the processor, the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the second aggregated performance data, wherein the modification is performed by the processor using a feedback control mechanism that adjusts the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor to optimize content performance metrics.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, and wherein the content element comprises a technical display parameter that affects how content is rendered on a display device.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the first rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, and wherein the processor applies a statistical algorithm to calculate the deviation value and uses the deviation value to adjust the first rule on probability factor in a manner that improves content performance optimization.
